name: PubMed 200k RCT: Sequential Sentence Classification in Medical Abstracts
description: PubMed 200k RCT is a major benchmark dataset for sequential sentence classification in medical research abstracts, developed by researchers at MIT and Adobe Research and presented at IJCNLP 2017. Sourced from MEDLINE/PubMed, the dataset comprises approximately 200,000 structured abstracts of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) containing over 2.2 million sentences. Each sentence is labeled according to its standardized rhetorical section role based on the CONSORT guidelines: Background, Objective, Method, Result, or Conclusion. PubMed 200k RCT serves as the standard evaluation suite for medical text summarization, information extraction, and semantic literature structuring.
